title: John Harbaugh expects Jameis Winston to remain QB1 no matter who Giants add at the position

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: John Harbaugh expects Jameis Winston to remain QB1 no matter who Giants add at the position
sources.description: It wasn't pretty — and it was only the winless Titans — but Jameis Winston won his first game as a starter since Dec. 15, 2024, when he was with the Browns.
